<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916949_theRebbe_558" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916949_theRebbe_558__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening heading and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B"S.</t>
    <t s="1">10 Shevat 5740*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that the text is a transcription (hanachah).</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">Transcription</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the verse "I have come to My garden, My sister, My bride," citing the Midrash and the Rebbe's maamar about the descent of the Shechinah through the work of seven tzaddikim, culminating in Moshe and the Mishkan.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"I have come to My garden, My sister, My bride"1,</t>
    <t s="1">And on this, the Rebbe, my master, father-in-law, the Rebbe of the hillula, brings in his maamar for the day of his histalkus and hillula,</t>
    <t s="2">that it is brought in Midrash Rabbah2</t>
    <t s="3">"To My garden" — to My bridal chamber,</t>
    <t s="4">to the place that was My primary [residence]</t>
    <t s="5">[meaning, the primary place of My dwelling]</t>
    <t s="6">at first,</t>
    <t s="7">for the primary Shechinah was in the lower realms,</t>
    <t s="8">and through the seven undesirable things, the Shechinah departed from below to above,</t>
    <t s="9">the Holy One, blessed be He, ascended higher and higher3,</t>
    <t s="10">up to the seventh firmament,</t>
    <t s="11">and afterwards, seven tzaddikim arose and brought down the Shechinah from above to below,</t>
    <t s="12">until Moshe, who is the seventh — and all sevenths are beloved4 — came</t>
    <t s="13">and brought it down below to earth.</t>
    <t s="14">And this is "The tzaddikim shall inherit the land and dwell forever upon it"5,</t>
    <t s="15">for the service of the tzaddikim is to cause the Shechinah to dwell and draw it down from above to below,</t>
    <t s="16">in the aspect of "ad" (until)</t>
    <t s="17">(as it is in the aspect of "He Who dwells on high and holy")</t>
    <t s="18">they shall cause it to dwell upon it,</t>
    <t s="19">below on earth,</t>
    <t s="20">in this lowest world, below which there is no lower.</t>
    <t s="21">Now, the beginning of the drawing down below through Moshe was at the time of the Giving of the Torah, as it is written6</t>
    <t s="22">"And God descended upon Mount Sinai,"</t>
    <t s="23">but in a permanent manner7</t>
    <t s="24">and in revelation, this was in the making of the Mishkan, as it is written8</t>
    <t s="25">"And they shall make Me a Sanctuary, and I will dwell in their midst."</t>
    <t s="26">And he continues in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="27">that the drawing down of the primary Shechinah in the lower realms</t>
    <t s="28">("and I will dwell in their midst")</t>
    <t s="29">was accomplished through the service of transforming darkness into light.</t>
    <t s="30">And this is why the Mishkan was made of shittim wood,</t>
    <t s="31">from which the planks were made,</t>
    <t s="32">as it is written9</t>
    <t s="33">"And you shall make the planks for the Mishkan of shittim wood, standing upright,"</t>
    <t s="34">"keresh" (plank) is the letters of "sheker" (falsehood), and it is the falsehood of the world,</t>
    <t s="35">which comes from the foolishness of idolatry,</t>
    <t s="36">"No person commits a transgression unless a spirit of foolishness enters into him"10,</t>
    <t s="37">and through the service of "And you shall make the planks for the Mishkan of shittim wood, standing upright,"</t>
    <t s="38">that they transform the foolishness of idolatry into the foolishness of holiness</t>
    <t s="39">("shittim wood"),</t>
    <t s="40">the falsehood of the world into the planks of the Mishkan</t>
    <t s="41">("planks for the Mishkan"),</t>
    <t s="42">through this is fulfilled "and I will dwell in their midst,"</t>
    <t s="43">the drawing down</t>
    <t s="44">(of the primary)</t>
    <t s="45">Shechinah in the lower realms.</t>
    <t s="46">And he adds in the maamar a precise reading of the verse "and I will dwell in their midst,"</t>
    <t s="47">"in its midst" is not said, but rather "in their midst" — within each and every one11,</t>
    <t s="48">for in each and every Jew, through the service of transforming darkness into light,</t>
    <t s="49">through this, the primary Shechinah dwells within him, as it was at the beginning of creation,</t>
    <t s="50">"I have come to My garden, to My bridal chamber,"</t>
    <t s="51">to the place that was its primary [place] at first,</t>
    <t s="52">and the primary dwelling is made in the lower realms.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
